explanation.headline: Oxaliplatin is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; our supply traces to Baxter Healthcare Corporation product labeled with FAREVA Unterach GmbH for Sandoz Inc.

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows oxaliplatin is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 57 vials of oxaliplatin 5 mg/mL, 10 mL (NDC 43066001401) from Baxter Healthcare Corporation, providing 20 days of supply at current use.
Corvale Lakeside holds 8 vials of the same product, providing 8.6 days of supply.
The product label names FAREVA Unterach GmbH for Sandoz Inc. as the manufacturing plant.

The recommended action is to transfer 6 vials of 5 mg/mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, which would leave Corvale General with 18 days and bring Corvale Lakeside to 15 days of supply.

rejected.text: FDA's shortage list records two discontinuations for oxaliplatin: Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted 2026-02-25 and Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. posted 2026-06-29, both listed as To Be Discontinued.
rejected.reason: "two" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: move the primary carboplatin contract from Accord to Teva and keep Accord as secondary. Rationale: Accord's supplier plant had an FDA warning letter; Teva supply steadier (demo history). Approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD.
